description: This file is a source code module for jQuery's CSS manipulation and style handling, including functions for vendor prefixing, box model adjustments, and CSS property hooks.

methods.name: vendorPropName
methods.description: Returns a vendor-prefixed CSS property name if necessary.

methods.name: finalPropName
methods.description: Returns the final CSS property name, considering vendor prefixes.

methods.name: setPositiveNumber
methods.description: Adjusts a CSS value to be a positive number with units.

methods.name: boxModelAdjustment
methods.description: Calculates adjustments needed for box model properties like width/height.

methods.name: getWidthOrHeight
methods.description: Retrieves the width or height of an element, accounting for box model.
